query: best python web framework for startup MVP
final_answer: FastAPI is usually the strongest default for a startup MVP because it combines fast development, modern typing, and async performance. Django is often the better choice when your team needs batteries-included admin workflows and mature built-in conventions.

claims.statement: FastAPI provides first-class async support and Python type hints.
Django includes a built-in admin and ORM that can accelerate CRUD-heavy products.

key_evidence.quote: FastAPI is based on standard Python type hints and Starlette.
The Django admin is one of the framework's signature productivity features.

uncertainties: Performance depends heavily on database design and deployment setup.
Team familiarity can outweigh framework feature differences in early-stage velocity.
